query: A soft elastic ball drops onto the ground and bounces several times while visibly deforming.
Place two soft elastic cubes with different stiffness values above the floor and let them fall at the same time to compare how much they deform after impact.

Create a scene with a large soft rubber bunny model resting on a platform. Drop several rigid metal spheres onto it from different heights and show the bunny compressing, wobbling, and recovering its original shape after the collisions.
A square piece of cloth falls onto a rigid box and drapes naturally over it.
Hang a rectangular cloth by its two top corners above the ground and apply a gentle sideways wind so the fabric swings back and forth.

Create a dining table scene with a detailed tablecloth model covering the table. Drop several rigid objects such as cups and plates onto the cloth and simulate realistic folds, sliding, and cloth deformation.
Pour water from a small height into an empty container and simulate realistic splashing.
Create two streams of colored liquid flowing from opposite sides into a bowl and show the liquids mixing together.
Build a kitchen sink scene where water continuously flows from a faucet into a transparent glass container, eventually overflowing onto the floor with visible splashes and fluid interaction.
Release a pile of dry sand above the ground and let it form a natural cone-shaped heap.
Drop a rigid sphere onto a flat layer of sand and simulate the sand scattering and forming a crater.
Create a sandcastle on uneven terrain and simulate part of the structure collapsing when a heavy rigid block rolls into it from a slope.
Place a shiny metallic sphere on the ground with a reflective silver appearance.
Create three cubes side by side with different surface appearances: matte red plastic, rough concrete, and polished gold metal.
Build a showroom scene containing a sports car model with glossy paint, reflective windows, metallic wheels, and a polished floor that reflects the environment lighting.
Record a video of a rigid ball falling onto the ground from a fixed side view camera.
Create a scene with two moving rigid cubes and place one camera above the scene and another at ground level to record the motion from different perspectives.
Load a humanoid robot walking across a room and create a cinematic recording with a moving camera that follows the robot while also capturing a wide-angle overview of the environment.
Apply a constant sideways wind force to a lightweight sphere suspended in the air.
Place several boxes on the ground and apply a pulsing upward force field that periodically lifts the lighter boxes into the air.
Create a storm scene with strong turbulent wind affecting hanging cloth, rolling rigid barrels, and falling debris at the same time.
Place a rigid sphere on a gently sloped terrain and let it roll downhill.
Generate uneven rocky terrain with hills and valleys, then drop several rigid cubes onto different locations to observe how they settle.

Create a large outdoor environment with mountainous terrain, scattered rocks, and rough paths. Simulate an off-road vehicle driving across the terrain while reacting realistically to bumps and slopes.
Simulate a quadcopter hovering steadily at a fixed height above the ground.
Create a drone that takes off, flies through several floating checkpoints, and lands at a target position.
Build an urban obstacle course with buildings and moving barriers. Simulate a drone autonomously navigating through the environment while avoiding collisions and maintaining stable flight.
Attach a depth sensor to a moving cube and visualize the measured distance to the ground.
Place a mobile robot in a room with obstacles and simulate a lidar sensor scanning the environment while the robot moves forward.
Load an autonomous vehicle model equipped with lidar, an IMU, and a forward-facing camera. Drive the vehicle through a cluttered environment and record synchronized sensor data during the motion.
Load a robotic arm and move its end effector to a target position above a table.
Create a robotic arm that picks up a small cube from one location and places it onto a nearby platform.
Load a humanoid robot in a warehouse environment and make it walk toward a shelf, grasp a box with both hands, and carry it to another location without dropping it.
Drop a rigid sphere into a container filled with water and simulate the splash.
Create a robotic arm that lifts a piece of cloth and drapes it over a rigid sphere resting on a table.
Build a disaster response scene where a drone scans uneven terrain while a humanoid robot walks through shallow water and pushes soft debris out of the way to reach a target object.
